- Cost: "成本按正常惩罚走就行" - cost follows normal penalty. The allowed shortfall costs are [10.0, 20.0, 40.0]. "正常惩罚" (normal penalty) is ambiguous - which one? "持有还是1" - cost_reserve = 1.0.

So the request specifies region ERCO, horizon 60 minutes, cost_reserve = 1.0, but the shortfall cost is ambiguous ("正常惩罚" = normal penalty). The allowed shortfall costs are 10.0, 20.0, 40.0. "正常惩罚" doesn't clearly map to one of these. This is ambiguous.

So this should be a "clarify" decision because cost_shortfall is ambiguous/missing.
